color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
INDEX INSULT
Large MI - myocarditis
decompensated HF - valve

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Contractile mass lost
Stroke volume falls

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CARDIAC OUTPUT FALLS
CI under 2.2 L/min/m2

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SYSTEMIC HYPOPERFUSION
MAP falls - lactate rises
oliguria - cool skin

div.style: color: rgb(22, 78, 99) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Blood backs up
LVEDP and PCWP rise
over 15 mmHg

div.style: color: rgb(22, 78, 99) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(131, 24, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CORONARY PERFUSION
PRESSURE FALLS
DBP minus LVEDP

div.style: color: rgb(131, 24, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SNS and RAAS
surge
catecholamines - AngII

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Afterload and heart rate rise
Myocardial O2 demand rises
Na and water retained

div.style: color: rgb(113, 63, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SIRS response
iNOS - NO - peroxynitrite
IL-6 - TNF alpha

div.style: color: rgb(113, 63, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
INAPPROPRIATE
VASODILATION
SVR falls - myocardial depression

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MULTI-ORGAN FAILURE
AKI - shock liver
bowel ischaemia - death
